"Beware" and "aware" are both derived from "ware" which is an Old English word basically meaning wary. "Beware" comes from "be" + "ware", and "aware" comes from "ġe-" + "ware". The "ġe" then morphed into "a" and acted as an intensifier, making the word mean "very wary".
